text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This paper presents original research focused on land-use/land-cover (LULC) prediction at the national scale for Japan, using spatially explicit modeling with multiple future scenarios (including business-as-usual and alternative scenarios). It develops national-scale LULC maps with 10 categories at 500 m resolution, simulates future land changes through 2050 using a calibrated land change model, and quantitatively validates the predictions with accuracy metrics including intensity analysis and figure of merit components. The study explicitly addresses scenario validation, compares multiple scenarios, and provides mapped LULC projections. Thus, it meets all core inclusion criteria (national scale, primary focus on LULC prediction, multiple scenarios, spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy assessment, mapped outputs) and none of the exclusion criteria. It is not a review article.)
